# Rule: Header-only template default unchanged

_Canonical rule slug:_ `header-only-template-default-unchanged`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A header-only class template keeps the same default argument on both sides. The template-default detector must emit nothing; this is the negative control for the header-only rules.
